title: wkjobs: AI process monitor
desc: Shows all AI processes in the console session with CPU%, memory, state, and spawned child commands
steps: PURPOSE: wkjobs.ps1 shows all AI processes (claude, codex, wkappbot, wkappbot-core*) sharing the current console session with CPU%, memory, thread count, idle/busy state, and full command lines. A separate SPAWNED section shows non-AI child processes directly launched by those AI pids.
COLORS: claude=Cyan(idle) or Green(BUSY), codex=Yellow or DarkYellow, wkappbot-core.new=Magenta, wkappbot-core=DarkGray. BUSY over 20% CPU, active 1-20%, idle under 1%
SESSION MARKER: * prefix means process is in current console session. Without -All, only current session procs are shown
SPAWNED SECTION: child processes of AI pids, conhost filtered. Columns: PPID (which AI spawned it), name, PID, CPU%, MEM, state, command line
INTERNALS: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process for CommandLine+PPID, Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process for CPU% snapshot, Get-Process for WorkingSet64+Threads+SessionId
NOTE: loop variable is apid not pid -- PowerShell PID is a reserved automatic variable for current process ID, using it as a foreach var causes ReadOnly error
WRAPPER: wkjobs.sh (bash) + wkjobs.cmd (CMD) are relative symlinks to wkwrap.sh in same dir. Run wkwrap.sh --install to add more. See also: wkappbot skill read wkwrap-ai-native-wrappers
SOURCE: wkjobs.ps1 lives in WKAppBot/bin/wkjobs.ps1 (edit there). scripts/wkjobs.ps1 is a symlink (mode 120000). wkjobs.sh relay uses local wkwrap.sh copy so wkfind.sh keeps SDK-specific wkfind.ps1.
PATH fix: prepend system dirs before codex exec to avoid PS shim shadowing system shell

RECURSIVE ANCESTOR WALK (2026-05-25): spawned-section check now uses Test-HasAiAncestor (depth-8 pid->parent walk) instead of direct-parent-only test. Fixes invisible bash/sh under claude->cmd->bash chains (cmd.exe parent was not in aiPids). -Leaks output now shows SHELLS(N) count and warns when >10. bash/sh NOT added to AI_NAMES -- they are tracked as spawned children only.
VERIFY: syntax-check edits by tokenizing the script via PSParser Tokenize, invoking the system shell by absolute path to avoid PATH-shim shadowing.

EDIT-VIA-WKEDIT note: wkedit re-applies indent-based block context, so multi-line inserts may keep slightly off cosmetic indentation -- harmless for .ps1 (whitespace-insensitive); verify braces balance by reading back the region.

LEAKS MODE OUTPUT FORMAT (2026-05-25): -Leaks now shows two counters: LEAKS(N) for zombie AI procs + SHELLS(N) for bash/sh under AI ancestors. Format: 'LEAKS(0): clean  |  SHELLS(15)' (green) or 'LEAKS(0): clean  |  SHELLS(15): >10 [warn]' (yellow if >10). When leaks found: 'LEAKS(N): agent-spawned zombies detected  |  SHELLS(N)' (red). bash/sh counted from spawned section using recursive ancestor walk.
bash/sh detection: Test-HasAiAncestor depth-8 walk added; -Leaks now shows SHELLS(N) count in output

requirements.expect: AI PROCESSES section with claude wkappbot codex rows
SPAWNED BY AI section with shell child processes of AI pids
